title: FrontDesk AI tickets
description: A list of tickets, one per question a patient sends. It is the value of the browser's localStorage key frontdesk.tickets, the body field tickets of POST /api/tickets (up to 20 at a time) and the tickets field of its GET reply. On the server each ticket is one row of the Postgres table tickets, whole in the data column, and is deleted seven days after it was made. chat.js builds the ticket and addTicket() in core.js adds id, created and staffReplies. The server keeps only the fields below and cuts each text to the length given.

id.description: T, the time in base 36, then two random characters, upper case. The staff page shows a display number (T-001, T-002) instead.

patient.description: The patient id from frontdesk.patient: P and five characters.

reply.description: The reply shown: the model's wording when it passed the guard, otherwise the rules engine's text.

source.description: model when the model's wording was used, file otherwise.

bookingTime.description: For a booking: the day and time read from the message. Empty for every other kind.

modelOk.description: true when the rules allowed the reply to be reworded by the model.

afterHours.description: true when the clinic was closed when the ticket was made.

callBack.description: true when the first status was needs human.

contactPhone.description: From the call-back form, with a country code.

created.description: Milliseconds since 1970. The server refuses a ticket dated more than a day ahead.

updated.description: Milliseconds since 1970. The server sets it to created when it is missing.

staffReplies.description: Replies sent from the staff page, oldest first.

remote.description: Only in a staff browser: the ticket came from another device. Never stored on the server.
